comments.author: @TestBakeryChannel
comments.text:
Sunday Challah

Ingredients
* 1000g all-purpose flour
* 2 tbsp active dry yeast
* 3 tsp salt
* 590ml lukewarm water

Instructions
1. Mix everything but the water.
2. Stream in the water and knead for 12 minutes.
3. Braid, proof and bake at 350°F for 35 minutes.
